definition: a poetical composition, in which each stanza commences with the same letter of the alphabet.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ಅಕ್ಕರಾಂಕಮಾಲೆಯನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That poet has composed the alliterative stanza-series very well.

definition: a kind of fragrant powder used on festival or marriage occasions.
example_en: At the wedding they applied the fragrant powder to the guests.

definition: the act of bearing; a putting on.
example_en: Abharana means the act of putting on an ornament.

definition: the state or quality of being unsteady; unstability; unsteadiness.
example_en: There is now a lot of unsteadiness in politics.

definition: a man who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: The liar's promise turned out to be false.

definition: a wooden hammer.
example_en: The sculptor carved the stone with a wooden hammer.

definition: a propounding of a principle, philosophy, etc.
example_en: He propounded a philosophy in the assembly.

definition: to be choked, stifled, checked, stopped.
example: ಮೀನಿನ ಮುಳ್ಳು ಗಂಟಲಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ಅವನು ತಿಣುಱಲಾರಂಭಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: A fish bone got stuck in his throat and he began to choke.

definition: the tree Ailanthus excelsa.
example_en: The yayi tree has grown near the village.

definition: a general or cursory look; a glance.
example_en: She looked at him with a glance.

definition: a period of rest and freedom fromwork, study, during the summer season; summer holiday.
example_en: The children went to the village during the summer holiday.

definition: the external female genitalia.
example_en: The doctor examined the external genitalia.

definition: wanting food; suffering from lack of food.
example_en: During the famine, people suffered, lacking food.

definition: a kind of wading bird with a long neck, long legs, and a long, tapered bill, living along marshes and river banks; a kind of heron.
example_en: The heron was waiting for fish on the riverbank.

definition: a poacher who catches animals as deer.
example_en: The poacher catches deer in the forest.

definition: the white-flowered, evergreen plant Thea sinensis (= Camelia thea, = C. sinensis) of Theaceae family; tea plant.
example_en: Tea plants were growing on the hill slope.

definition: want of resort, recourse; destitution.
example: ಆ ಬಡವನ ಅಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಮನಸ್ಸು ಕರಗಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that poor man's destitution, the heart melted.

definition: to be realised for an instant in the mind; to flash.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ನೆನಪು ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣ್ಮಲೆದುದು.
example_en: That old memory flashed in his mind.

definition: any of large, brownish shorebirds of Numenius genus and Scolopacidae family, with long legs and a long, down-curved bill; a curlew.
example_en: The curlew was walking about in the sand.

definition: a warming up or treating of something with hot sand.
example_en: The doctor advised applying hot sand treatment to the leg.

definition: Vyāsa, the famous sage-poet.
example: ಮಾಠರ ಎಂಬ ಹೆಸರಿನಿಂದ ವ್ಯಾಸ ಮಹರ್ಷಿಯನ್ನು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The sage Vyasa is called by the name Matharaby some.

definition: a man doing menial work; a servant.
example_en: The servant did all the work of the house.

definition: the earth, the world of human beings.
example_en: Human beings live in the mortal world.

definition: any of the fingers of the hand.
example_en: Glass pricked her finger.

definition: a kind of bird.
example_en: A bird called hudikiluga was hiding inside the bush.

definition: to force something to bend backward or inward as to form a curve.
example_en: The blacksmith bent the iron rod.

definition: a room where meals are eaten; a dining room.
example_en: They led the guests to the dining room.

definition: a hard, amorphous, brittle, usu. transparent, substance, a bad conductor of electricity, made of the oxides of silicon; glass.
example_en: This bottle is made of glass.

definition: a war-chariot.
example_en: The king came to the battlefield in a war-chariot.

definition: a piece of solid material fitting tightly into a hole, used to fill a gap or cavity or act as a wedge or stopper; a plug.
example: ಬ್ಯಾರೆಲ್‌ನ ರಂಧ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಮರದ ಗಿಡುಕು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: They fitted a wooden plug into the hole of the barrel and closed it.

definition: favourable estimation in which a person is commonly held based on brilliance of achievement, status, magnanimity, etc.; reputation; prestige.
example: ಅವನ ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆಯಿಂದ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ತಕ್ಕಾಮೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿತು.
example_en: Because of his honesty his reputation in the town grew.

definition: a thorny bush.
example_en: The thorny bush had grown dense beside the paddy field.

definition: a kind of disease characterised by the bending of the bones, caused by deficiency of vitamin D; rickets.
example_en: The child developed rickets due to nutritional deficiency.

definition: a man who holds a parasol (over the head of a king, monarch, as a regalia).
example_en: The parasol-bearer stood respectfully in front of the king.

definition: a man who calls, shouts loudly; a shouter.
example: ಆ ಕೂಗುಗ ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಸಾಮಾನು ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That shouter was selling goods loudly in the market.

definition: a specialist in economics; an economist.
example: ಆ ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞ ದೇಶದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: That economist spoke about the country's economic condition.

definition: a tuft-like trinket worn by women on their forehead.
example_en: The shining forehead trinket gleamed on her forehead.

definition: continually; ever; always.
example_en: The water of that river keeps flowing continually.

definition: to laugh with shrill, broken sounds; to cackle.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಕೆಕ್ಕರಿಸಿ ನಗುತ್ತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಗಮನಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That boy, cackling loudly, watched everyone.

definition: to jump or leap forward.
example_en: That cat leapt forward onto the wall.

definition: both the ends of a sari.
example_en: Both the ends of her sari fluttered in the wind.

definition: the work, profession of a commission agent or broker.
example_en: His father too was an expert in the profession of broking.

definition: one who believes in optimism.
example: ಆಶಾವಾದಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದೇ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: An optimist always believes that good will happen.

definition: a slender hollow bamboo, with holes along its length, used as a musical instrument; a musical bamboo-pipe.
example_en: The cowherd blew the bamboo-pipe and played music.

definition: quickly; hurriedly.
example_en: The child came running quickly into the house.

definition: a kind of rose plant (of Rosaceae family) with red colour flower; red rose.
example_en: She plucked the red rose flower.

definition: an ink made of lac.
example_en: The writer wrote on the page using lac ink.

definition: the service of a person for which an endowment is given.
example_en: That priest performed the endowed service of the village.
The astrologer fixed the wedding time in Simha lagna.

definition: the back part of the human foot, under the ankle and behind the instep; the heal.
example_en: While running, his heel got injured.

definition: in a small degree; to a slight extent; only slightly; not much; little.
example_en: He does not have even the slightest bit of mercy.

definition: a step put backward.
example_en: He took a step backward out of fear.

definition: name of the last year in the sixty-years cycle.
example_en: They marked the year named Acchaya in the almanac.

definition: green grass.
example_en: Green grass grew all over the field during the rainy season.

definition: to cause to receive or accept; to hand over.
example_en: The merchant handed over the goods to the customer.

definition: the act of giving, offering, presenting (humbly).
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ಒಡವೆಗಳನ್ನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಣೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She made an offering of her jewellery to the temple.

definition: a female swan.
example_en: That female swan was swimming with her young ones.

definition: (drinking or swallowing) in a single gulp.
example_en: He swallowed the medicine in a single gulp.

definition: a unit of various weights as a) 2,240 lb avoirdupois (1016.05 kg); long ton; b) 2,000 lb avoirdupois (907.19 kg); short ton; c) 1,000 kilograms (2,204.62 lb); metric ton.
example: ಈ ಟ್ರಕ್ ಎರಡು ಟನ್ ಸಾಮಾನನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯಬಲ್ಲದು.
example_en: This truck can carry two tons of goods.

definition: a thin, burnt piece, made of clay used for roofing; a tile.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಮನೆಯ ಮೇಲ್ಛಾವಣಿಗೆ ಪಂಚು ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: Tiles have been used on the roof of that village house.

definition: an iron tool, having a heavy metal head and a blade, fixed to a long wooden handle, for chopping trees or splitting wood; an axe.
example_en: The farmer chopped the tree branch with the axe.

definition: the chief of a group, clan or village.
example_en: The chief of the village listened to everyone's problems.

definition: without delay; immediately.
example_en: He finished that work immediately, without delay.

definition: the act of pressing hard or closely.
example_en: He pressed hard on the wound.

definition: the spinal column; backbone.
example_en: The doctor examined the condition of the backbone in the X-ray.

definition: a kind of weapon of a stone or cylindrical piece of wood, studded with iron spikes.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಶತಘ್ನಿ ಎಂಬ ಆಯುಧ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Ancient soldiers used a weapon called shataghni.

definition: a room meant to be a shop; a stall.
example_en: He rented a new shop stall in the market.

definition: (masc.) a member of a troupe of musicians who provide background music.
example_en: The background musician stood with the troupe and played the chende drum.

definition: to become transformed; to assume a different form.
example_en: That demon transformed into a human form.

definition: the place at which a fluid is taken into a pipe, channel, etc.; an intake.
example_en: Debris had collected near the intake of the canal.

definition: the condition of being deteriorated or useless; deterioration; a wasting away; spoilt condition.
example_en: The grain deteriorated and became spoilt due to moisture.

definition: any blood vessel that carries blood from some part of the body back toward the heart; a vein.
example_en: During the surgery, the doctors connected the vein.

definition: an incomplete poetry.
example_en: What he wrote is just an incomplete poem, not finished.

definition: a pouch made by stretching the front portion of the loose garment worn round the waist by a man or woman, to hold something.
example_en: The farmer put the corn grains into the pouch of his garment.

definition: the plant Pimenta acris of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: They use the leaves of the Pimenta acris plant in cooking.

definition: the act of clapping; sound of clapping.
example_en: As soon as the speech ended in the assembly, the sound of clapping was heard.

definition: moving ahead; leading others.
example_en: The vanguard soldiers led the army forward.

definition: (the mouth) to become dry; to have the necessity for drinking water; to become thirsty.
example_en: Walking in the sun, his mouth became dry with thirst.

definition: a long shaft with a pointed end used for piercing; a spear.
example_en: He hunted the wild boar with a spear.

definition: a tiny particle of anything; a jot; an atom.
example_en: There was not a single tiny flaw in his work.

definition: the Supreme Being.
example_en: Worship was conducted for the idol of the Supreme Being in the temple.

definition: the thin hard, but breakable outer part of something that has become dry and crisp (as the crust that has formed on a dried wound).
example_en: The dried crust on the wound peeled off.

definition: the literal power or sense of a word.
example_en: The literal sense of that word was very clear.

definition: that which is completely filled with.
example_en: That pond was completely filled with water.

definition: a sprout branched forth into two shoots.
example_en: After the rain, a two-branched sprout appeared on the plant.

definition: a lashing with a whip or cane stick (as a punishment).
example_en: The teacher gave the student a punishment of caning.

definition: people of beastly nature.
example_en: Those people of beastly nature have no mercy.

definition: to cause to sell.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಏಜೆಂಟನ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He had his house sold through an agent.

definition: to become mixed, blended or united.
example_en: The two colours blended and became mixed together.

definition: name of an ancient physician of India.
example_en: Bahata was a renowned physician of ancient India.

definition: to be pleased; to have pleasure; to be glad.
example: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನು ಬಹಳ ಸಂತಸವಾನ್ ಆದನು.
example_en: Hearing the result, he became very pleased.

definition: a beautiful foot.
example_en: The dancer's beautiful foot attracted the onlookers.

definition: the work of weaving fabrics on looms.
example_en: Weaving of cloth is famous in this village.

definition: a closet or cabinet with shelves for holding clothes, valuables, etc.; a cupboard.
example_en: She arranged the clothes in the cupboard.

definition: a refinement by means of low heat or by heating for a short time.
example_en: The gold was refined through gentle low-heat treatment.

definition: the condition of being closed (as the petals of a flower).
example_en: The closing of the flower's petals is seen at night.

definition: the plant Desmodium motorium (= D. gyrans) of Papilionaceae family; telegraph plant.
example_en: The leaf of the kadu-hulli plant sways in the wind.

definition: a book in which all receipts and payments of cash are recorded; a cash-book.
example_en: Every transaction of the shop is written in the cash-book.

definition: the disk of the sun; the sun-disk.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಸಱವಟ್ಟನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The poet has beautifully described the sun-disk in his poem.

definition: one who helps, supports another or others.
example_en: He was a good helper in my work.

definition: the possessive form of the pronoun they; 'their'; theirs.
example_en: Their house is outside the town.

definition: cajoling, coaxing words.
example_en: The child gave in to his cajoling words.

definition: a seat, sofa, couch etc. made using wool or downs of birds.
example_en: There was a soft down-filled seat in the king's chamber.

definition: the shape made by two straight lines meeting at a common point, the vertex or by two planes meeting along an edge; an angle.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಗೋಡೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಕೋಣ್ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: An angle was formed between those two walls.

definition: highly informal speech, of servant class, that is outside conventional or standard usage and consists both of coined words and phrases and of new or extended meanings attached to established terms.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಬೀದಿಯ ಆಳುಭಾಷೆ ಬಳಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ನಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That boy made everyone laugh by using street slang.

definition: the outer corner of the eye; the end of the eye that is away from the nose.
example_en: Tears rolled down from the outer corner of her eye.

definition: to beat or strike with or as with a flail; to thresh heavily.
example_en: The farmers are threshing the dried paddy straw heavily.

definition: of a former time; bygone; past.
example_en: It is good to forget past events.

definition: a studying thoughtfully and critically as to find the merit, importance, worth, etc.
example_en: His writing needs to be critically reviewed.

definition: mouth ulcer.
example_en: A mouth ulcer formed from hot food.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example_en: The boy put his fingers in his mouth and blew a loud whistle.

definition: a mystical weapon, of which Brahma is the presiding deity.
example_en: The sage bound the demon with the Brahmapasha weapon.

definition: something that is or is acting in an intermediate position or location.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಎರಡು ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಮಧ್ಯಮವರ್ತಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: That officer stood as an intermediary between the two parties.

definition: blazingly burning coal.
example: ಆ ಒಲೆಯ ಪಣ್ಗೆಂಡ ಕತ್ತಲಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲಿತು.
example_en: The blazing coal from that hearth cast light in the darkness.

definition: the selling or buying of goods in relatively large quantities and usu. at lower prices than at retail; wholesale.
example_en: His livelihood depends on wholesale trade.

definition: to reflect the sound waves as to reproduce the sound; to echo.
example_en: The sound spoken inside the cave echoed back.

definition: a heavy stroke; a bang.
example: ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಅವಘಾತ ಇಡೀ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The heavy bang on the door startled the whole house.

definition: a contagious disease, the most common form of plague, caused by a bacterium (Yersinia pestis) transmitted by fleas from infected rats, and characterised by buboes, fever, prostration, and delirium; bubonic plague.
example: ಪ್ಲೇಗು ರೋಗ ಹಲವು ಜನರ ಪ್ರಾಣ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: The plague disease claimed the lives of many people.

definition: proper, right or suitable manner.
example_en: He welcomed everyone in a proper and suitable manner.

definition: to be awake.
example_en: The watchman stayed awake all night.

definition: the first day of the Kārtīka, the eighth month in Hindu lunar calendar.
example_en: A special worship took place at home on Balipadya day.

definition: a small cloth bag for carrying betel leaves and areca nuts.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ತನ್ನ ಅಡಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಿಕೆ ಎಲೆ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: Grandfather kept betel leaves and areca nuts in his small cloth bag.

definition: one who cheats others by deception; a cheat; a fraud; a deceiver.
example: ಆ ಜಲಿಕ ಜನರನ್ನು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಿ ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That deceiver cheated people by telling lies.

definition: a small hand-staff fixed with a signet used to mark the signature on a letter, document, packet, etc.
example_en: The officer marked the document with the signet-staff.

definition: a knowing, understanding or realising.
example_en: Through the teacher's realisation, he understood the truth.

definition: a kind of fever.
example_en: That fever was cured quickly.

definition: a race between horses with riders, usu. with stakes; a horse-race.
example_en: His horse ran first in the horse race.

definition: a man who cheats; a cheat; a pretender.
example: ಆ ಗನ್ನಗಾಱ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಹಣ ಕಸಿದನು.
example_en: That cheat deceived people and snatched their money.

definition: a pair of footwear.
example_en: He bought a new pair of footwear and wore it.

definition: a female jackal (Canis aureus).
example_en: The female jackal howled with its cubs at night.

definition: to go beyond; to trespass; to violate.
example_en: The soldiers trespassed beyond the border.

definition: the cactus plant Opuntia dillenii of Cactaceae family; prickly pear.
example_en: That hill was overgrown with prickly pear cactus.

definition: the hog Sus scrofa from which domestic hogs are derived; wild boar.
example_en: A wild boar was roaming about in the forest.

definition: the thick, slimy secretion of the mucous membranes in the nose, that moistens and protects them; mucus of the nose.
example_en: Due to the cold, his nose was filled with mucus.

definition: to include in, mix with (as to combine or blend); to join together.
example_en: They mixed all the ingredients together in the cooking.

definition: a distinctive mark on the body.
example: ಅವನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಂಕವರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The distinctive mark on his hand attracted everyone's attention.

definition: a thin slab or bent piece of baked clay used for roof covering; a tile.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಮೊದಲು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಹೆಂಚು ಹಾಕಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Before the rainy season they had new tiles fitted to the house.

definition: a crowd; a multitude.
example_en: A crowd had gathered in the market.

definition: of current times.
example_en: Current-day fashion is of a different kind altogether.

definition: (in gen.) an unchaste woman; harlot; a whore.
example_en: The townspeople blamed her as an unchaste woman.

definition: a variety in coconut trees.
example_en: There are many butter-coconut trees in their garden.

definition: to cause to drag; to make (another) hauled.
example_en: He had the rope pulled and made the cart hauled.

definition: a chair of State for a sovereign; a throne.
example_en: The king was seated on the throne.

definition: the act, practice or quality of being hospitable; solicitous entertainment of guests.
example_en: His hospitality earned everyone's admiration.

definition: one loop or ring of a chain etc.; a link.
example: ಆ ಸರಪಳಿಯ ಒಂದು ಕೊಲಿಕೆ ಮುರಿದು ಹೋಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: One link of that chain had broken.

definition: a relatively small star in the sky.
example_en: A small star appeared in the evening sky.

definition: the act of a violent, lawless criminal; hoodlumism.
example_en: The police took action against the hoodlumism.

definition: the story of one's own life written, dictated or narrated by oneself .
example_en: His life story inspired the readers.

definition: to make sharp or sharper; to sharpen.
example_en: The worker made the knife sharp.

definition: the condition of being jumbled, complicated or is perplexing, solving which is difficult.
example: ಈ ಲೆಕ್ಕದ ಲಚಂಡವನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took him an hour to solve the jumble of this account.

definition: (myth.) Tripura, supposed to had been built in the sky.
example_en: The myth says that Tripura was built in the sky.

definition: a kind of venereal disease.
example_en: Treatment was given to the patient suffering from that venereal disease.

definition: the act or process of frying something in a pan without using oil, ghee, etc.
example_en: Grandmother did the pan-frying without using butter.

definition: a docorating or being decorated; decoration.
example: ರಥದ ಸಿಸ್ತು ಜಾತ್ರೆಯ ದಿನ ಬಹಳ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The decoration of the chariot was very fine on the festival day.

definition: a place where bodies of dead persons are cremated; a crematory.
example_en: The village crematory is on the riverbank.

definition: not small or little in size, quantity, big.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಅನಲ್ಪ ಜನಸಂದಣಿ ಸೇರಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large (not small) crowd of people had gathered near that house.

definition: greatness; eminence; superiority; distinction.
example_en: The hero's distinction is recorded in history.

definition: (rushing) in an agitated or hurried manner.

example: ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದ ಸಮಯ ಆಕಾಶದ ತುಂಬ ಕೆಂಚು ಹರಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: At sunset, the red colour spread across the whole sky.

definition: a tree that has born fruits.
example_en: A fruit-bearing mango tree stood in the garden.

definition: much higher in some quality or degree; much above the ordinary or average; existing in a high degree; intense.
example_en: Today's match was intensely thrilling.

definition: of reddish brown colour.
example_en: The color of that clay pot is reddish brown.

definition: to cause persistent or recurrent distress of body or mind with the arrogance of power or strength; to torture; to torment.
example_en: The powerful king used to torment the weak with his might.

definition: a controlling; a control; a restraint.
example: ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಅಡಕ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವನು ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದ.
example_en: Without control over his mind, he spoke in anger.

definition: the state, status, rank, etc. of a sovereign king.
example_en: That king attained the status of a sovereign ruler.

definition: the variation of either the focal length or the magnification of a lens system with different wavelengths of light, characterised by prismatic colouring at the edges of the optical image and colour distortion within it; chromatic aberration.
example: ಈ ಮಸೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣವಿಪರ್ಯಯದಿಂದ ಚಿತ್ರದ ಅಂಚು ಮಸುಕಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Due to chromatic aberration in this lens, the edge of the image is blurred.

definition: an ancient method of trial in which the accused had to drink a poison and it was believed that he or she would survive if innocent; an ordeal of poison.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿರ್ದೋಷಿತ್ವ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In ancient times, they used to determine innocence through the ordeal of poison.

definition: anything that comes about as a consequence or outcome of some action, process, etc.; result.
example_en: The result of the exam was published today.

definition: a large gathering of people, animals, etc.; a multitude.
example_en: A large gathering of people had assembled at the fair.

definition: to come forward or to the front of.
example_en: He came forward at the time of danger.

definition: the plant Withinia somnifera of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The root of the anguru plant is used for medicine.

definition: one who holds partial ownership of a property; a share-holder.
example_en: He is a shareholder of this company.

definition: a government by upper-class people; aristocracy.
example: ಆ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕುಲೀನತಂತ್ರ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆ ನಡೆಸಿತು.
example_en: In that country, aristocratic rule prevailed for centuries.

definition: to propel a boat by rowing; to row.
example_en: The fishermen rowed the boat across the river.
